title: Add a report parameter and refresh a dataset after the report exists
instruction: In the sandbox model, scaffold an SSRS report named DemoRptParam over the ConDemoNoteHeader table with generate_object(mode="scaffold", objectType="report", fieldsHint="NoteId, Subject", generateController=false). Then make the two changes a developer needs AFTER a report exists, using d365fo_file(action="modify", objectType="report", operation="report-design") — never by hand-editing the XML: (1) add a field NoteDateTime (EDT TransDateTime) to the temp table with d365fo_file(action="modify", objectType="table", operation="add-field"), then surface it on the report's dataset with reportAction="refresh-dataset" and tableName set to the temp table; (2) declare a visible date parameter named DemoRptFromDate with reportAction="add-parameter", parameterDataType="System.DateTime" and promptString="@SYS14656" — leave parameterHidden OFF, because a visible parameter omits <UserVisibility> entirely and there is no "Visible" value in shipped metadata. Do NOT touch the RDL: placing the field or the parameter in the design is Report Designer work and no tool here writes it. Build the model; it must compile.
